attachments.origin_landmark: external surfaces of ribs 5-12 (interdigitating with serratus anterior and latissimus dorsi)
attachments.insertion_landmark: iliac crest (anterior half of the outer lip), inguinal ligament, and linea alba via the aponeurosis

actions: laterally flexes and contralaterally rotates trunk (unilateral)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers run obliquely inferomedially ('hands in pockets' direction) -- the most superficial of the three flat abdominal wall layers, and the layer whose fiber direction most differs from transversus abdominis's purely transverse fibers deep to it.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
